## Exercise 1 (Read the data)

```{r}
# Absolut sti til data, uanset system:
sti_pop <- here::here("world_population.csv")

# Indlæs data:
wpop_full <- readr::read_csv(
  file = sti_pop,
  skip = 4)

wpop_full <- wpop_full |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    country = `Country Name`,
    code = `Country Code`
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(- c(`2023`, `Indicator Name`, `Indicator Code` ))

# 

```


## Exercise 2 (get iso-codes)

```{r}
wiki_url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1"
iso_codes_all <- rvest::read_html(wiki_url) |> 
  rvest::html_elements("table") |> 
  rvest::html_table() |> 
  purrr::pluck(3) |> 
  dplyr::select(name = 1, iso3 = 3, independent = 6)
iso_codes_all
```




## Exercise 3 (iso codes from independent countries)

```{r}
iso_codes <- iso_codes_all |> 
  dplyr::filter(independent == "Yes")
```


## Exercise 4

```{r}
wpop <- wpop_full |> dplyr::semi_join(iso_codes, by = c("code" = "iso3"))
```

## Exercise 5

```{r}
wpop |>
  dplyr::left_join(iso_codes, by = c("code" = "iso3")) |> 
  dplyr::select(name, code, country) |> 
  dplyr::filter(name != country)

```




## Exercise 6 (get continents)

```{r}
wiki_url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_sovereign_states_and_dependent_territories_by_continent_(data_file)"
continents <- rvest::read_html(wiki_url) |> 
  rvest::html_elements("table") |> 
  rvest::html_table(convert = FALSE) |> 
  purrr::pluck(3) |> 
  dplyr::select(continent = 1, iso3 = 3)
continents
```



## Exercise 7

```{r}
wpop2 <- wpop |> 
  dplyr::left_join(continents, by = dplyr::join_by(code == iso3)) |> 
  dplyr::relocate(continent)
wpop2
```

## Exercise 8 (make pop_long)

```{r}
pop_long <- wpop2 |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::matches("[[:digit:]]{4}"),values_to = "pop",
    names_to = "year") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(year = as.integer(year))

pop_long
```
